## 3. Slack Lagging and Performance Issues

Experiencing lag or slow performance in the Slack desktop app can be frustrating, especially during busy work periods. This Slack problem might manifest as delayed message loading, slow channel switching, or general unresponsiveness. Common culprits include accumulated cache, an outdated app version, heavy resource usage by Slack or other apps, or network latency.
